records.text:
Coimbatore's horticulture page lists MIDH-NHM, NADP, RKVY-Per Drop More Crop, RAD-IFS, SHDS, TNIAMP and PMFBY. Under MIDH protected cultivation it describes 50% polyhouse assistance at Rs.467.50 per square metre and 50% shade-net assistance at Rs.355 per square metre, each with a maximum area of 4,000 square metres per beneficiary. Packhouse support is listed as 50%, capped at Rs.2 lakh.
The page describes application through the Uzhavan app, horticulture portals or submission to the block Assistant Director of Horticulture. Listed documents include an application with photo, original Chitta/Adangal, FMB sketch, Aadhaar, bank-passbook first-page copy, ration-card copy and photographs. For joint patta it calls for co-owner NOC; lessees must provide a registered lease agreement. Cultivation-related components require soil and water test reports. Assistance above Rs.50,000 requires an affidavit.
The page says leases should be at least 10 years for project-based components and RKVY-PDMC. Water-dependent components require assured irrigation. Confirm component availability with the department.
records.source: Horticulture schemes and application documents - Coimbatore

records.text:
The Tiruvallur Horticulture page describes micro irrigation under Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY). It lists assistance of 100% for small and marginal farmers and 75% for bigger farmers, with financial assistance up to 5 hectares. It states that beneficiaries can receive assistance to renew laterals after seven years. Trench-cutting assistance is listed as Rs.3,000 per hectare, limited to 2 hectares per beneficiary.
For horticulture applications, the page lists current Chitta, Adangal, field map, passport photograph, ration card copy, Aadhaar copy and nationalised bank passbook copy. A small/marginal farmer certificate is required where applicable to obtain 100% micro-irrigation support. Organic-farming assistance requires an organic certificate.
The page says landowners are eligible; leases for project-based components should be at least 10 years. Assured irrigation is necessary for components that require water. These are district-page descriptions, not confirmation of an open application window in 2026.
